Purpose: Automated maintenance for solar panel efficiency
Problem: Dust accumulation on solar panels reduces efficiency and requires frequent manual cleaning
Solution: An automated rail-based cleaning system with scheduled and remote operation to maintain panel performance
Architecture: Distributed cleaning units with a centralized master controller handling multiple panels
Control Modes: Manual remote control via mobile app
Scalability Design: Master controller managing multiple panel units
Performance Goal: Reduce manual intervention and maintain optimal solar efficiency
Challenges: Designing a reliable rail-based movement system
Ensuring uniform cleaning across the panel surface
Outcome: Demonstrates the ability to design scalable real-world automation systems combining electronics, mechanics, and control logic
Portfolio Value: Shows a real-world industrial automation system
Highlights a scalable multi-panel cleaning architecture
Demonstrates direct application in renewable energy efficiency improvement
